note: Miller County MO publishes no zoning district service: its GIS (Assessor MapServer, Geocortex sites) lists parcels, jurisdictions and aerial imagery but no zoning layer. City of Lake Ozark zoning exists only inside a public ArcGIS Online web map (CLO_Zones_Web, embedded feature collection, no queryable service); Eldon zoning is in its eCode360 ordinance with an official map, not a queryable layer.
